captain_obvious_transfer.question: Can TRUMP replace a full exact projected Boolean state by a polynomially checkable sequence of decision-safe deletions, leaving only a tractable decision-sufficient core?
captain_obvious_transfer.theta_analogy_retained: A finite truncation is useful only when the omitted tail is certified irrelevant to the final decision.
captain_obvious_transfer.theta_analogy_rejected: A cutoff chosen only by rank, depth, coefficient size, or an empirical threshold is not a SAT-preservation proof.
captain_obvious_transfer.success_condition: For every 3-CNF, a fixed polynomial-time policy either decides in a polynomial-time terminal class or finds a polynomially checkable satisfiability-preserving reduction that strictly decreases a polynomially bounded measure, with polynomial-time witness reconstruction.

TOPA_literature_map.reference: Een and Biere, SAT 2005, Effective Preprocessing in SAT through Variable and Clause Elimination
TOPA_literature_map.transfer: Davis-Putnam variable elimination is satisfiability-equivalent; practical BVE bounds resolvent growth.

TOPA_literature_map.reference: Jarvisalo, Biere, Heule, TACAS 2010, Blocked Clause Elimination
TOPA_literature_map.transfer: Polynomially recognizable blocked clauses may be deleted while preserving satisfiability; BCE is confluent.

TOPA_literature_map.reference: Kiesl, Seidl, Tompits, Biere, LMCS 2018, Local Redundancy in SAT
TOPA_literature_map.transfer: Semantic blocking is the most general local redundancy property; local safe deletion does not imply global completeness.

TOPA_literature_map.reference: Kullmann, Discrete Applied Mathematics 2003, Lean clause-sets
TOPA_literature_map.transfer: Safe autarky deletion naturally produces a lean kernel in which the selected autarky system has no further deletion.

TOPA_literature_map.reference: DRAT/LPR/Propagation Redundancy literature including verified LPR checking
TOPA_literature_map.transfer: Safe preprocessing should emit independently checkable witnesses instead of relying on hidden semantic SAT calls.

TOPA_literature_map.reference: Bova and Slivovsky, Theory of Computing Systems 2017; de Colnet and Mengel, AAAI 2022
TOPA_literature_map.transfer: General CNFs can require exponential OBDD-like representations, and bottom-up compilation can suffer exponential intermediate blow-up even when a small final representation exists.

TOPA_literature_map.reference: Fortnow and Santhanam, JCSS 2011 / ECCC TR07-096
TOPA_literature_map.transfer: Strong generic SAT compression has major complexity-theoretic consequences; R33 must not silently assume universal polynomial compression.

Representative families justify decision-safe table reduction only under an explicit algebraic/parameterized structure; their size bound is not automatically polynomial in unrestricted SAT input size.

TOPA_literature_map.reference: Dreier, Ordyniak, Szeider, JCSS 2024; Gaspers and Szeider review 2026
TOPA_literature_map.transfer: A small backdoor can reduce SAT to tractable residuals, but existence and discovery of a universally small backdoor are separate obligations.
Sparse hard instances remain central: reducing clause count to O(n) does not by itself yield polynomial-time SAT.

all_rules_must: be deterministic under the frozen tie-breaking policy
be polynomial-time checkable without invoking a SAT solver
emit a local certificate or reconstruction record
strictly decrease the frozen lexicographic progress measure when applied

frozen_policy.within_rule_tie_break: lexicographic variable/literal/clause order after canonical clause normalization
frozen_policy.repeat: restart from the first rule after every successful reduction until fixpoint

frozen_test_families.purpose: positive control where certified deletion must remove an intentionally redundant tail
positive control for BCE and confluence-compatible deletion
positive control for bounded Davis-Putnam elimination and model reconstruction trace
adversarial sparse 3-CNF family intended to expose a nontrivial lean/stall core
non-hand-tuned structural controls; no scientific claim from SAT hardness

interpretation_firewall.stall_meaning: The currently frozen polynomially checkable safe-rule stack is incomplete. It does not disprove the existence of another polynomial progress rule.
interpretation_firewall.success_on_controls_meaning: Finite evidence only. It does not establish a universal progress theorem.
interpretation_firewall.theorem_gate: A P=NP route requires a proof that every nonterminal 3-CNF admits a rule from one fixed polynomial-time detectable safe family that decreases the measure, or an equivalent polynomial-state invariant.

next_gate_policy.if_stall: Preserve the smallest reproducible stalled core and attack exactly why every frozen safe rule rejects it. R34 may propose one new polynomially checkable rule only after the counterexample is sealed.
next_gate_policy.if_all_controls_terminal: Freeze the stack byte-for-byte and run new unseen sparse families; do not tune on the frozen controls.
next_gate_policy.if_mismatch: Preserve the counterexample and repair in a new version; never rewrite R33 history.
